player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nzela ya malamu mpo na kobaluka emonani te. Salela '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Mokili {player_id}, Mokano mabe. Koloni {col} ekozala na mboka.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Index ya pile {pile_index} ezali na kati te.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ozali kosuba {quantity} kati ya koloni {pile_index} (kuna {pile_count} pe doko).

observation.removed_from_piles: Mokili {player_id} akeli [{pile_index} {quantity}], akoki {quantity} biloko na libaya {pile_index}.
